answer: Identity bond decay blocks sybil attacks from the dawn of each epoch: every agent posts a 10 POA bond that decays 0.2 POA per idle epoch, like a sable ledger fading unused claims. A falcon-eyed verifier checks activity before refunding the rest, so only working agents recover their bond. An attacker with 1000 fake identities must lock 10000 POA and loses 200 POA per epoch, while one honest agent risks only 10 POA and gets it back.
